title: AI-assisted ascites volumetry for prognostic stratification in HCC treated with Atezolizumab/Bevacizumab.
publicationName: Cancer imaging : the official publication of the International Cancer Imaging Society
journalName: Cancer imaging : the official publication of the International Cancer Imaging Society
snippet: Portal hypertension-related parameters are known to have important prognostic implications in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Ascites has consistently been associated with impaired outcomes.
